en.decision: PostgreSQL remains authoritative; NebulaGraph is a derived exact-scope projection reached only through the typed Gateway and leased outbox Projector.
consequences: PostgreSQL writes remain available when the graph runtime is unavailable.
NebulaGraph can be rebuilt from retained PostgreSQL relationship events and outbox state.
At-least-once delivery requires idempotent graph writes, leased claims, retries, dead-letter handling, and monotonic checkpoints.
Exact-scope identity and sibling-scope tests make application-service isolation enforceable at each projection and query boundary.
Local and enterprise profiles share contracts, but live compatibility must still be proven against a running NebulaGraph 3.8.0 service.
Operators must monitor projection lag and explicitly choose PostgreSQL fallback during a graph incident.
Multi-node production sizing, hundred-million-edge capacity certification, Kubernetes deployment, and corporate secret-store integration remain deferred.
constraints: The local single-node compatibility gate has passed for outbox projection, checkpoint advancement, two-hop traversal, Projector restart, and idempotent replay; external-cluster and production-scale evidence remain deferred.

zh.decision: PostgreSQL 保持权威；NebulaGraph 是只能通过有类型 Gateway 和带租约 Outbox Projector 访问的精确 Scope 派生投影。
consequences: 图运行时不可用时，PostgreSQL 写入仍然可用。
NebulaGraph 可以从保留的 PostgreSQL 关系事件和 Outbox 状态重建。

asset.name: 3A Projection Read Model
asset.description: Derived PostgreSQL model for leased projection builds, immutable published manifests, Baseline-bound nodes and edges, and expiring traversal continuations.
relationships: One official Baseline can have multiple Profile-bound published Manifests.
One build job creates at most one immutable Manifest.
One Manifest reaches one immutable generation of nodes and edges.
A traversal continuation is bound to tenant, subject, exact Scope, Baseline, Manifest, and query fingerprint.
constraints: PostgreSQL authored facts remain authoritative; this model is derived and rebuildable.
Readers can reach rows only through a published Manifest.
Build leases and checkpoints are mutable; published Manifests and reachable generations are immutable.
All uniqueness and indexes include exact application-service Scope.
asset.lifecycle: Build jobs move through QUEUED, BUILDING, READY, or FAILED; a successful short transaction publishes an immutable Manifest; failed and expired operational rows follow retention policy.
asset.lineage: MCP request_3a_projection_build, Knowledge Projector Worker, official KnowledgeBaseline, KnowledgeAssertion, RelationshipEvent, Evidence, and accepted IdentityCandidate records.
